description:
Delete a locally stored secret by name. Warns when a stack still references it.

Use when: the user asks to remove a secret they no longer use.

Do NOT use when: the user wants to replace a value — ask them to run
`clawops secret rotate <NAME>`; no tool takes a secret value (R6).

name.description: The secret's name, as clawops_secret_list reports it

yes.description: Skip the confirmation. Only when the user has already approved this deletion

name: clawops_secret_delete
title: Delete a Stored Secret (DESTRUCTIVE)
